name: Stéphanie Yon-Courtin - Après le § 50 - Am 12
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 50a. Expresses concern that extensive aid frameworks linked to the Clean Industrial Deal, the Green Deal and similar initiatives have contributed to higher energy costs and increased regulatory burdens; stresses that such centralised subsidy policies often fail to enhance genuine competitiveness and instead shift costs onto consumers and businesses while expanding bureaucratic oversight at EU level;
